theorems.name: Submission.bf_plane_vitali_disjoint_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (ι : Type) (S : Set (Rn N)) (t : Set ι) (c : ι → Rn N) (ρ : ι → ℝ), S ⊆ (W : Set (Rn N)) → (∀ i ∈ t, c i ∈ W ∧ 0 < ρ i) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ i ∈ t, c i = x ∧ ρ i ≤ ε) → ∃ u ⊆ t, u.Countable ∧ u.PairwiseDisjoint (fun i ↦ (W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall (c i) (ρ i)) ∧ μHE[n] (S \ ⋃ i ∈ u, ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall (c i) (ρ i))) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
